description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Revise the Fuel Price to be effect from 12.00 midnight on 01.02.2023
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 66 of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961, revising fuel prices. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to implement regulatory changes rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or other specialized categories.
